On September 21, 2026, Carter's, Inc. (the "Company") announced that its limited duration stockholder rights agreement (the "Rights Agreement"), dated as of September 22, 2025, by and between the Company and Equiniti Trust Company, LLC, as rights agent, expired in accordance with its terms.
